description: Land Acquisition - Jayanthi Wewa, Padavi Sripura D/S Division, Trincomalee District - Udugoda, Kegalle D/S Division, Kelalle District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government, including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and locations. The document is explicitly labeled as "PART III - LANDS" and "Land Acquisition Notices," and involves the Minister of Lands directing acquisition officers to take possession of the specified lands. This fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
